reviewsInfo.customersSay: Customers find the house numbers look fantastic, with one noting the high-quality brushed silver finish. The product receives positive feedback for its quality, adhesion, and ease of installation, with one customer mentioning they sit flush and secure on the mailbox.

reviews.reviewText: We recently updated our curb appeal with these 3 Inch Modern House Numbers in Brushed Silver, and they look fantastic! The sleek, contemporary design really elevates the look of my mailbox and matches well with our home’s exterior. The brushed silver finish feels high-quality and has held up well against the weather so far — no fading or discoloration. Installation was quick and easy with the included hardware, and the numbers sit flush and secure on the mailbox. They’re the perfect size — easy to read from the street, but not oversized — and have made it much easier for visitors and delivery drivers to find our house. Overall, these house numbers are an affordable, stylish upgrade that delivers great results. Highly recommend!
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on December 30, 2025

reviews.reviewText: Received 2 out of 3 numbers right away. Finally received the 3rd number, but did not put them on our our steel mailbox post until yesterday. They seemed to adhere to the post quite well and hope they last a long time considering the individual cost of each one. We put these on the post because the seasonal mailbox covers hide the mailbox numbers on the opposite side. We want substitute postal mail delivery employees to know which box is ours!
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on December 25, 2025

reviews.reviewTitle: Sharp looking, high quality, super sticky backing
reviews.reviewText: These are great. They are high quality, super sharp looking, and have very sticky backing. They were perfect for placing on my new metal mailbox post. Too bad they are among the highest priced numbers of all 3-inch versions on Amazon at the time, but I couldn't get the numbers I needed in the style I wanted in a timely fashion from other listings.
reviews.reviewDate: Reviewed in the United States on July 28, 2025

reviews.reviewTitle: They lasted through winter and salt season.
reviews.reviewText: Nice quality and the backing is super strong! It lasted though a strong winter season. The 3M backing is he key to it lasting. There are 4 numbers in all, and they all lasted and look good. I'd buy them again.

reviews.reviewTitle: Nice weight and easy to apply
reviews.reviewText: The script is clean and easy to read from a distance. Each number is a good weight, easy to apply to my street side mailbox and has a nice brushed finish that isn’t too shiny. Even the Amazon driver complimented them saying they made it easier to find the right house because previously it was etched into a stone on the house. Love this inexpensive improvement!

reviews.reviewText: I recently purchased the 3 Inch Modern House Numbers in brushed finish, and I couldn't be happier with them! They were spot on perfect for my mailbox, giving it a sleek and modern look that I was aiming for. The quality of the product is impressive, the numbers feel sturdy and well-made. The adhesive tape is strong and held up beautifully, ensuring they stay securely in place. Overall, these house numbers are a fantastic choice for anyone looking to update their mailbox or enhance their home's curb appeal. Highly recommend!
